references.text: Hezron is mentioned as a son of Reuben in the genealogy when Jacob and his family went to Egypt.
Hezron and Karmi are mentioned as sons of Reuben, Israel's firstborn.
The first census of the tribe of Reuben, which included the Hezronites and Karmites.
Hezron is listed among the sons of Reuben in the genealogies of Chronicles.
